name: Oriental Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Oriental Energy Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of carbon-based materials in China. It operates through Liquefied Petroleum Gas, Chemical Products, and Logistics Service segments. The company also offers propylene and polypropylene, synthetic ammonia, hydrogen, and others. In addition, it is involved in the provision of industrial product warehousing services; and ship investment and operation management. Oriental Energy Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
